source.title: Citizen's Charter 2026
source.read_from: The charter's own List of Services, PDF pages 6 to 18, read from the PDF's text layer and checked against a second text extraction and the page images.

notes: Titles and office names are as printed, with line breaks joined, long dashes written as hyphens, and gaps the text layer added inside words removed.
page is the printed first page of the service. Printed page = PDF page - 18.

The list heads the services on printed pages 538 to 557 "OFFICE OF THE CITY BUDGET OFFICER", a second time. Those pages belong to the Office of the City Treasurer, so office says so and office_listed_as keeps the list's heading.
The list gives printed page 557 for Cooperative Dissolution and its first part. The service starts on page 577, so page says 577 and page_listed keeps 557.
part_of names the numbered service that a lettered or decimal entry belongs to. The list itself prints both.
from_page holds a few lines copied from the service's own charter page, added by hand (2026-11-16, page 324) where the list's title alone hides what a resident asks for.
